18 Aug
Senior Social: Book Swap Parks and Recreation

10:00 AM| Clara B. Mounce Public Library, 201 E. 26th Street

Adults 55 and older are invited to a Senior Social on Tuesday, Aug. 18, from 10 - 11 a.m. at Clara B. Mounce Public Library.

Bring your favorite book, tell the group why you love it, and then pick a new book to take home. It’s great way to connect with other readers and discover new titles.

This Senior Social is free.

21 Aug
Senior Citizens Day Parks and Recreation

5:30 AM| Bryan Aquatic Center, 3100 Oak Ridge Drive, Bryan, TX 77802

In honor of National Senior Citizens Day, ages 55+ can purchase half-priced pool passes. 25-punch passes and annual passes will be available, and must be purchased in-person at the Bryan Aquatic Center. The 25-punch pass is valid for two years, and the annual pass is good for one year from the date of purchase.

21 Aug
Senior Splash Bash Parks and Recreation

5:30 PM| Bryan Aquatic Center, 3100 Oak Ridge Drive, Bryan, TX 77802

Get ready for a Senior Splash Bash! Adults 55 and older are invited to celebrate National Senior Citizens Day with a Hawaiian-themed pool party. 

The event will feature swimming, games, and music. Costumes are encouraged, but a swimsuit is required to enter the pool.

Admission is $4 per person at the gate. Presale tickets are not available. Half-priced pool passes will be available for purchase.

Food vendors will be on-site. Water bottles are permitted, but outside food and drinks are not allowed.

21 Aug
Maroon & White Night Downtown

6:00 PM| Historic Downtown Bryan, 100 N. Main St., Bryan, TX 77803

Join us for an evening in Historic Downtown Bryan tailored for Texas A&M University and System employees and their loved ones every third Friday evening.

More Maroon & White Night Information

Enjoy an evening filled with live entertainment, delicious local cuisine, and unique bars and shops. This is the perfect opportunity to meet up with colleagues, make new friends, and enjoy a fun and relaxing night out. Whether you’re looking to unwind after a long week or explore what Downtown Bryan has to offer, this event is for you!

There will be a variety of specials and discounts just for showing your Texas A&M employee ID or business card.
